svg.title: Monocyte
svg.desc: Large monocyte with kidney-shaped nucleus, abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, and small vacuoles. Biological basis: Circulating monocytes have folded or reniform nuclei and lysosome-rich cytoplasm that supports differentiation into phagocytes.
